notes.title: SIMULACRA 3 REVEAL!
notes.content:
Beware the Beldam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734168/6aea361a12e6c7a454507c36a86489b9418d226e.gif

Kaigan Games and Neon Doctrine are excited to announce the third chapter of their critically acclaimed found phone horror series, Simulacra. 
We invite you to explore a charming little town, and a new frontier of digital horror.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35734168/0b7eb53b80bbd12107c5a0c591a923f2990bf90d.png

The once charming town of Stonecreek has seen better days. People are vanishing into thin air, leaving nothing behind but strange symbols where they were last seen. With the police baffled and the populace terrified, rumors swirl that it is the doing of the Beldam, the ghost of a witch that once haunted the streets of Stonecreek
[previewyoutube=xUl0Qr4DWjA;full][/previewyoutube]
You are the intern at the local paper, tasked with assisting the town’s star journalist, Ruby Myers, on her investigation into the disappearances. Your only lead is the phone of the missing Paul Castillo, a software developer, an amateur historian of the town, and one of Ruby’s sources. While Ruby does the legwork, your job is to hack into Paul’s phone for any clues left behind. New apps, exciting features, and fresh terror await those who delve into the darkest corners of the digital realms as you investigate the Beldam of Stonecreek.

notes.title: Doctor Who: The Lonely Assassins is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
You’ve explored the voyeuristic horrors of picking up a stranger’s phone in Sara is Missing and SIMULACRA, you’ve seen what evils await those who poke around where they shouldn’t. notes.title: Christmas Update - BEGIN +, Subtitles and SALE!
notes.content:
Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30893666/87a2de4f4caf0ded51310b1eb0d8f2cabd323a49.gif

In case you didn't know, SIMULACRA is having a 30% discount in conjunction with Steam's winter sale. With that, we also included some quality of life improvements of the game.

 BEGIN + 
After completing the game for the very first time, you have to play the game again in "BEGIN + " mode. It will dramatically increase the text speed for a quicker playthrough to get the multiple endings. Of course, this is not recommended if you still prefer the complete immersive experience

 SUBTITLES 
We messed up on this one. While SIMULACRA is mostly a text-based game, we do have FMV and voice messages scattered throughout. We checked the "subtitles" box without considering that players with hearing impairments will miss out these specific contents. We have since corrected this and enable an option to turn on subtitles. Just go to the HELP section in the Main Menu and turn it on. We want as many people to enjoy this game and hope that this feature will make that easier.

That's all for this year. For more news on the game, you know where to find us :)
